subject: [RFC PATCH v3 7/8] mm/gup: walk multiple PTEs per follow_page_pte() call

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the `follow_page_pte` function to walk multiple PTEs in a single call, reducing the number of page-table descents and lock acquisitions. This improves performance by eliminating redundant work for adjacent pages from different folios or plain base pages with no folio relationship. The patch was measured to reduce median get time by 2-3 times on various test cases.
